"""Service boundary for remote Universal Worker submission and status.

This module is intentionally thin. It does not implement another queue,
publisher, scheduler, Git client, SQL executor or Worker. Submission is
delegated to the existing canonical job factory and gate-chain publisher.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping

from tools.mirror_sync import gate_chain_publisher
from tools.mirror_sync.worker_job_factory import canonicalize_job
from tools.mirror_sync.worker_result_reader import read_canonical_result
from tools.mirror_sync.worker_result_status import build_job_status

from .semantic_capabilities import (
    SemanticCapabilityError,
    resolve_capability,
)


REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
STATE_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue"
JOB_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{2,120}$")

_SENSITIVE_KEYS = {
    "password",
    "password_decrypted",
    "secret",
    "secrets",
    "token",
    "credentials",
    "credential",
    "api_key",
    "apikey",
}

_SAFE_RESULT_KEYS = {
    "status",
    "quality_gate",
    "certification",
    "work_completion",
    "certification_basis",
    "certified_source_sha",
    "converged_head",
    "development_sha",
    "reconciliation_status",
    "published_result_commit",
    "published_result_sha256",
    "attestation_sha256",
    "tests",
    "percent_complete",
    "blockers",
    "files_changed",
    "commit_sha",
    "integrated_commit",
    "git_sync_status",
    "production_touched",
    "completed_at_utc",
    "summary_es",
    "result_detail_evidence",
}


class WorkerIngressError(ValueError):
    pass


def _clean(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _assert_no_sensitive_keys(value: Any, path: str = "request") -> None:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        for key, nested in value.items():
            normalized = str(key).strip().lower()
            if normalized in _SENSITIVE_KEYS:
                raise WorkerIngressError(f"SENSITIVE_FIELD_FORBIDDEN:{path}.{key}")
            _assert_no_sensitive_keys(nested, f"{path}.{key}")
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        for index, nested in enumerate(value):
            _assert_no_sensitive_keys(nested, f"{path}[{index}]")


def _requester_from_authenticated_user(
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    project: str,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    email = _clean(current_user.get("email")).lower()
    if not email or "@" not in email:
        raise WorkerIngressError("AUTHENTICATED_REQUESTER_EMAIL_REQUIRED")

    return {
        "email": email,
        "source": "edarsahub-worker-ingress",
        "project": _clean(project) or "EDARSAHUB",
        "chat": "remote-canonical-ingress",
    }


def build_canonical_job(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = dict(request_payload)
    _assert_no_sensitive_keys(payload)

    scheduling = payload.get("scheduling")
    scheduling = dict(scheduling) if isinstance(scheduling, Mapping) else {}

    requester = _requester_from_authenticated_user(
        current_user,
        project=_clean(scheduling.get("project_id")) or "EDARSAHUB",
    )

    raw_job = {
        "job_id": payload.get("job_id"),
        "objective": payload.get("objective"),
        "mode": payload.get("mode"),
        "actions": list(payload.get("actions") or []),
        "checks": list(payload.get("checks") or []),
        "requester": requester,
    }
    if scheduling:
        raw_job["scheduling"] = scheduling

    return canonicalize_job(raw_job)


def submit_job(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Submit only through the existing canonical publisher."""
    canonical_job = build_canonical_job(
        request_payload,
        current_user=current_user,
    )
    result = gate_chain_publisher.submit(canonical_job)
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise WorkerIngressError("CANONICAL_PUBLISHER_INVALID_RESPONSE")

    safe = dict(result)
    safe["job_id"] = _clean(result.get("job_id")) or canonical_job["job_id"]
    safe["production_touched"] = bool(result.get("production_touched", False))
    safe.pop("template", None)
    return safe


def _semantic_job_id(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    requester_email: str,
) -> str:
    bounded_context = _clean(request_payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    capability = _clean(request_payload.get("capability")).upper()
    request_key = _clean(request_payload.get("request_key"))
    stable_payload = {
        "requester": requester_email.lower(),
        "objective": _clean(request_payload.get("objective")),
        "bounded_context": bounded_context,
        "mode": _clean(request_payload.get("mode")).upper(),
        "capability": capability,
        "request_key": request_key,
        "constraints": request_payload.get("constraints") or {},
    }
    digest = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(
            stable_payload,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ).encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()[:20].upper()
    prefix = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9._-]+", "-", bounded_context)[:32] or "EDARSAHUB"
    cap = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9._-]+", "-", capability)[:32] or "CAPABILITY"
    return f"SEM-{prefix}-{cap}-{digest}"[:121]


def build_semantic_job(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = dict(request_payload)
    _assert_no_sensitive_keys(payload)

    objective = _clean(payload.get("objective"))
    bounded_context = _clean(payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    requested_mode = _clean(payload.get("mode")).upper()
    capability_code = _clean(payload.get("capability")).upper()

    if not objective:
        raise WorkerIngressError("OBJECTIVE_REQUIRED")
    if not bounded_context:
        raise WorkerIngressError("BOUNDED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED")

    try:
        capability = resolve_capability(capability_code)
    except SemanticCapabilityError as exc:
        raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc

    allowed_modes = tuple(str(mode).upper() for mode in capability.modes)
    if requested_mode not in allowed_modes:
        raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_MODE_MISMATCH")

    if capability.builder is None:
        raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_DIRECT_SUBMISSION_REQUIRED")

    try:
        expansion = capability.builder(payload)
    except SemanticCapabilityError as exc:
        raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc

    if not isinstance(expansion, dict):
        raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_INVALID_EXPANSION")

    requester = _requester_from_authenticated_user(
        current_user,
        project="EDARSAHUB",
    )

    job_id = _semantic_job_id(
        payload,
        requester_email=requester["email"],
    )

    raw_job = {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "objective": objective,
        "mode": requested_mode,
        "actions": list(expansion.get("actions") or []),
        "checks": list(expansion.get("checks") or []),
        "scheduling": dict(expansion.get("scheduling") or {}),
        "requester": requester,
    }
    return canonicalize_job(raw_job)


def submit_objective(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = dict(request_payload)
    _assert_no_sensitive_keys(payload)

    objective = _clean(payload.get("objective"))
    bounded_context = _clean(payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    capability_code = _clean(payload.get("capability")).upper()
    requested_mode = _clean(payload.get("mode")).upper()

    if not objective:
        raise WorkerIngressError("OBJECTIVE_REQUIRED")
    if not bounded_context:
        raise WorkerIngressError("BOUNDED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED")

    try:
        capability = resolve_capability(capability_code)
    except SemanticCapabilityError as exc:
        raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc

    allowed_modes = tuple(str(mode).upper() for mode in capability.modes)
    if requested_mode not in allowed_modes:
        raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_MODE_MISMATCH")

    requester = _requester_from_authenticated_user(
        current_user,
        project="EDARSAHUB",
    )

    if capability.submitter is not None:
        try:
            result = capability.submitter(payload, requester)
        except SemanticCapabilityError as exc:
            raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc

        if not isinstance(result, dict):
            raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_INVALID_RESPONSE")

        publication = result.get("publication")
        if not isinstance(publication, dict):
            raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_REPAIR_PUBLICATION_MISSING")

        publication_state = _clean(
            publication.get("publication_status")
        ).upper()
        if publication_state not in {"PUBLISHED", "EXISTS"}:
            raise WorkerIngressError(
                "SEMANTIC_REPAIR_PUBLICATION_NOT_COMMITTED"
            )

        job_id = _clean(
            publication.get("repair_job_id")
            or result.get("job_id")
            or (result.get("job") or {}).get("job_id")
        )
        if not job_id:
            raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_REPAIR_JOB_ID_MISSING")

        safe = {
            "status": "SUBMITTED",
            "job_id": job_id,
            "production_touched": False,
            "capability": capability_code,
            "bounded_context": bounded_context,
        }
        return safe

    canonical_job = build_semantic_job(
        payload,
        current_user=current_user,
    )
    result = gate_chain_publisher.submit(canonical_job)
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise WorkerIngressError("CANONICAL_PUBLISHER_INVALID_RESPONSE")

    safe = dict(result)
    safe["job_id"] = _clean(result.get("job_id")) or canonical_job["job_id"]
    safe["production_touched"] = bool(result.get("production_touched", False))
    safe["capability"] = capability_code
    safe["bounded_context"] = _clean(payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    safe.pop("template", None)
    return safe


def _read_json_if_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {}
    return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {}


def _safe_terminal_fields(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        key: payload.get(key)
        for key in _SAFE_RESULT_KEYS
        if key in payload
    }


def get_job_status(job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = _clean(job_id)
    if not JOB_ID_RE.fullmatch(value):
        raise WorkerIngressError("JOB_ID_INVALID")

    result_path = STATE_ROOT / "results" / f"{value}.json"
    if result_path.is_file():
        result_read = read_canonical_result(
            result_path,
            expected_job_id=value,
        )
        status = build_job_status(result_read=result_read)
        if result_read.terminal_result_valid and isinstance(
            result_read.payload, dict
        ):
            status.update(_safe_terminal_fields(result_read.payload))
            if not status.get("commit_sha"):
                commit_sha = (
                    result_read.payload.get("certified_source_sha")
                    or result_read.payload.get("development_sha")
                    or result_read.payload.get("integrated_commit")
                )
                if commit_sha:
                    status["commit_sha"] = commit_sha
        status["lifecycle"] = "RESULT"
        return status

    rejected_path = STATE_ROOT / "rejected" / f"{value}.json"
    if rejected_path.is_file():
        payload = _read_json_if_object(rejected_path)
        response: dict[str, Any] = {
            "job_id": value,
            "lifecycle": "REJECTED",
            "status": str(payload.get("status") or "REJECTED"),
            "quality_gate": "FAIL",
            "tests": "FAIL",
            "certification": "NOT_CERTIFIED",
            "work_completion": "REJECTED",
            "percent_complete": 0,
            "blockers": list(payload.get("blockers") or ["job_rejected"]),
            "terminal_result_valid": False,
            "result_state": "RESULT_REJECTED",
            "production_touched": False,
        }
        for key in ("completed_at_utc", "summary_es"):
            if key in payload:
                response[key] = payload[key]
        return response

    published_path = STATE_ROOT / "published" / f"{value}.json"
    done_path = STATE_ROOT / "done" / f"{value}.json"
    if published_path.is_file() or done_path.is_file():
        absent_read = read_canonical_result(
            result_path,
            expected_job_id=value,
        )
        status = build_job_status(result_read=absent_read)
        status["lifecycle"] = "RESULT"
        return status

    non_terminal_dirs = (
        ("PROCESSING", "processing"),
        ("PENDING", "pending"),
        ("DRAFT", "drafts"),
    )

    for lifecycle, directory in non_terminal_dirs:
        path = STATE_ROOT / directory / f"{value}.json"
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        payload = _read_json_if_object(path)
        return {
            "job_id": value,
            "lifecycle": lifecycle,
            "status": lifecycle,
            "certification": "NOT_CERTIFIED",
            "work_completion": lifecycle,
            "percent_complete": 0,
            "terminal_result_valid": False,
            "result_state": "RESULT_NON_TERMINAL",
            "production_touched": False,
            "summary_es": payload.get("summary_es"),
        }

    return {
        "job_id": value,
        "lifecycle": "NOT_FOUND",
        "status": "NOT_FOUND",
        "production_touched": False,
    }

"""Minimal MCP transport for the certified EDARSAHUB semantic ingress."""

from typing import Any

try:
    from mcp.server import MCPServer
except ImportError:  # mcp 1.x (backend-compatible: starlette 0.37)
    from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP as MCPServer
from mcp.server.auth.middleware.auth_context import get_access_token
from mcp.server.auth.provider import TokenVerifier
from mcp.server.auth.settings import AuthSettings
from mcp.server.transport_security import TransportSecuritySettings
from mcp.types import ToolAnnotations
from pydantic import AnyHttpUrl

from .auth import EdarsahubTokenVerifier
from .client import (
    get_job_status as backend_get_job_status,
    submit_objective as backend_submit_objective,
)
from .config import WorkerMcpConfig


_BACKEND_URL: str | None = None


def _bearer_token() -> str:
    access_token = get_access_token()
    if access_token is None or not access_token.token:
        raise PermissionError("MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED")
    return str(access_token.token)


def _backend_url() -> str:
    if not _BACKEND_URL:
        raise RuntimeError("MCP_BACKEND_NOT_CONFIGURED")
    return _BACKEND_URL


def submit_objective_tool(
    objective: str,
    bounded_context: str,
    mode: str,
    capability: str,
    request_key: str | None = None,
    constraints: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Submit one approved semantic objective to the EDARSAHUB Universal Worker."""
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "objective": objective,
        "bounded_context": bounded_context,
        "mode": mode,
        "capability": capability,
        "constraints": constraints or {},
    }
    if request_key:
        payload["request_key"] = request_key

    result = backend_submit_objective(
        backend_url=_backend_url(),
        token=_bearer_token(),
        payload=payload,
    )

    return {
        "status": result.get("status"),
        "job_id": result.get("job_id"),
        "capability": result.get("capability"),
        "bounded_context": result.get("bounded_context"),
        "production_touched": bool(
            result.get("production_touched", False)
        ),
    }


def get_job_status_tool(
    job_id: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read the canonical status of one Universal Worker job."""
    result = backend_get_job_status(
        backend_url=_backend_url(),
        token=_bearer_token(),
        job_id=job_id,
    )
    return {
        "job_id": result.get("job_id"),
        "lifecycle": result.get("lifecycle"),
        "status": result.get("status"),
        "certification": result.get("certification"),
        "work_completion": result.get("work_completion"),
        "certification_basis": result.get("certification_basis"),
        "certified_source_sha": result.get("certified_source_sha"),
        "converged_head": result.get("converged_head"),
        "quality_gate": result.get("quality_gate"),
        "tests": result.get("tests"),
        "percent_complete": result.get("percent_complete"),
        "blockers": result.get("blockers"),
        "files_changed": result.get("files_changed"),
        "commit_sha": result.get("commit_sha"),
        "git_sync_status": result.get("git_sync_status"),
        "terminal_result_valid": result.get("terminal_result_valid"),
        "result_state": result.get("result_state"),
        "production_touched": result.get(
            "production_touched",
            False,
        ),
        "summary_es": result.get("summary_es"),
        "result_detail_evidence": result.get(
            "result_detail_evidence"
        ),
    }


def build_mcp_server(
    config: WorkerMcpConfig,
    *,
    token_verifier: TokenVerifier | None = None,
    **settings: Any,
) -> MCPServer:
    global _BACKEND_URL
    _BACKEND_URL = config.backend_url.rstrip("/")

    verifier = token_verifier or EdarsahubTokenVerifier(
        backend_url=config.backend_url,
        resource_url=config.resource_url,
    )

    mcp = MCPServer(
        "EDARSAHUB Universal Worker",
        instructions=(
            "Use submit_objective to send approved semantic objectives to "
            "EDARSAHUB. Use get_job_status to read their canonical status. "
            "No low-level worker actions are exposed."
        ),
        token_verifier=verifier,
        auth=AuthSettings(
            issuer_url=AnyHttpUrl(config.issuer_url),
            resource_server_url=AnyHttpUrl(
                config.resource_url
            ),
            required_scopes=[],
            validate_token_resource=False,
        ),
        **settings,
    )

    mcp.tool(
        name="submit_objective",
        title="Submit EDARSAHUB objective",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=False,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(submit_objective_tool)

    mcp.tool(
        name="get_job_status",
        title="Get EDARSAHUB Worker job status",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=True,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(get_job_status_tool)

    return mcp


def build_transport_security(
    config: WorkerMcpConfig,
) -> TransportSecuritySettings:
    return TransportSecuritySettings(
        allowed_hosts=list(config.allowed_hosts),
        allowed_origins=list(config.allowed_origins),
    )

"""Observabilidad sanitizada del HTTP 400 del upstream MCP (solo logging; sin cambio funcional)."""
import contextlib
import importlib
import json
import logging
import sys
import types

import httpx
import pytest
from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


def _load_gateway():
    """Import the gateway with OAuth router stubbed so the test needs no SQL config."""
    oauth_name, gateway_name = "modules.worker_mcp.oauth_server", "modules.worker_mcp.gateway_router"
    saved = {name: sys.modules.get(name) for name in (oauth_name, gateway_name)}
    stub = types.ModuleType(oauth_name)
    stub.router = APIRouter()
    sys.modules[oauth_name] = stub
    sys.modules.pop(gateway_name, None)
    try:
        return importlib.import_module(gateway_name)
    finally:
        for name, module in saved.items():
            if module is None:
                sys.modules.pop(name, None)
            else:
                sys.modules[name] = module


gateway_router = _load_gateway()

SECRET = "SECRET-TOKEN-VALUE-123"
COOKIE = "SESSIONCOOKIE-ABC"
BODY_SECRET = "BODY-SECRET-XYZ"
LOGGER = "edarsahub.worker_mcp.gateway"


class _FailingStream(httpx.AsyncByteStream):
    async def __aiter__(self):
        raise httpx.ReadError("boom")
        yield b""  # pragma: no cover


def _client(monkeypatch, handler):
    monkeypatch.setenv("EDARSAHUB_MCP_UPSTREAM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:32913")
    monkeypatch.delenv("EDARSAHUB_MCP_INPROCESS", raising=False)
    real = httpx.AsyncClient
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        gateway_router.httpx, "AsyncClient",
        lambda **kw: real(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler), **kw),
    )
    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(gateway_router.router)
    return TestClient(app)


def _post(client, body=None, **headers):
    base = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {SECRET}", "Cookie": f"sid={COOKIE}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json, text/event-stream",
    }
    base.update(headers)
    payload = body if body is not None else json.dumps(
        {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize", "params": {"note": BODY_SECRET}}
    )
    return client.post("/api/mcp", content=payload, headers=base)


def _rpc_error(code):
    return httpx.Response(
        400, json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": None, "error": {"code": code, "message": f"x {BODY_SECRET}"}},
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("body,expected", [
    (b'{"error":{"code":-32700,"message":"m"}}', ("parse_error", -32700)),
    (b'{"error":{"code":-32600,"message":"m"}}', ("invalid_request", -32600)),
    (b'{"error":{"code":-32602,"message":"m"}}', ("invalid_params", -32602)),
    (b'{"error":{"code":-32000,"message":"m"}}', ("jsonrpc_other", -32000)),
    (b"Invalid Content-Type header", ("content_type_invalid", None)),
    (b"Bad Request: Missing session ID", ("session_id_missing", None)),
    (b"not json at all", ("unclassified", None)),
    (b'{"error":"plain"}', ("unclassified", None)),
    (b'{"error":{"code":true}}', ("unclassified", None)),
    (b"x" * 70000, ("oversized", None)),
])
def test_classification_uses_closed_vocabulary(body, expected):
    assert gateway_router._classify_400(body) == expected


def test_400_is_passed_through_unchanged_and_logged_sanitized(monkeypatch, caplog):
    upstream = httpx.Response(
        400, headers={"content-type": "application/json", "x-internal": "leak"},
        json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": None, "error": {"code": -32602, "message": BODY_SECRET}},
    )
    client = _client(monkeypatch, lambda request: upstream)
    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger=LOGGER):
        reply = _post(client, **{"MCP-Protocol-Version": "2099-01-01"})
    assert reply.status_code == 400
    assert reply.json()["error"]["code"] == -32602
    assert reply.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
    assert "x-internal" not in reply.headers
    lines = [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if r.name == LOGGER]
    assert len(lines) == 1
    line = lines[0]
    assert "mcp_upstream_400" in line and "rpc_method=initialize" in line
    assert "error_class=invalid_params" in line and "jsonrpc_code=-32602" in line
    assert "content_type=json" in line and "accept=json+sse" in line
    assert "protocol_version=unknown" in line and "has_auth=true" in line
    for forbidden in (SECRET, COOKIE, BODY_SECRET, "Bearer", "2099-01-01", "sid="):
        assert forbidden not in line


def test_unknown_request_method_is_not_echoed(monkeypatch, caplog):
    client = _client(monkeypatch, lambda request: _rpc_error(-32600))
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": f"custom/{BODY_SECRET}"})
    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger=LOGGER):
        _post(client, body=body)
    line = [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if r.name == LOGGER][0]
    assert "rpc_method=other" in line and BODY_SECRET not in line

class _StubTokenVerifier:
    async def verify_token(self, token: str) -> AccessToken | None:
        if token != SECRET:
            return None
        return AccessToken(
            token=token,

def _build_real_upstream():
    cfg = WorkerMcpConfig(
        issuer_url="http://127.0.0.1:32913",
        resource_url="http://127.0.0.1:32913/mcp",
        backend_url="http://127.0.0.1:8001",
        allowed_hosts=("127.0.0.1:*", "localhost:*"),
        allowed_origins=(),
    )
    mcp_server = build_mcp_server(
        cfg,
        token_verifier=_StubTokenVerifier(),
    )
    upstream_app = mcp_server.streamable_http_app(
        json_response=True,
        stateless_http=True,
        transport_security=build_transport_security(cfg),
        host=cfg.bind_host,
    )
    return mcp_server, upstream_app


@contextlib.contextmanager
def _gateway_with_real_upstream(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("EDARSAHUB_MCP_UPSTREAM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:32913")
    monkeypatch.setenv("EDARSAHUB_MCP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN", "https://edarsahub.example.com")
    monkeypatch.delenv("EDARSAHUB_MCP_INPROCESS", raising=False)
    _mcp_server, upstream_app = _build_real_upstream()
    real_async_client = httpx.AsyncClient

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def _lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
        async with upstream_app.router.lifespan_context(upstream_app):
            yield

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        gateway_router.httpx,
        "AsyncClient",
        lambda **kw: real_async_client(
            transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=upstream_app),
            **kw,
        ),
    )
    app = FastAPI(lifespan=_lifespan)
    app.include_router(gateway_router.router)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        yield client


def _init_payload(protocol_version: str = "2025-06-18") -> str:
    return json.dumps({
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "id": 1,
        "method": "initialize",
        "params": {
            "protocolVersion": protocol_version,
            "capabilities": {},
            "clientInfo": {"name": "chatgpt-connector", "version": "1.0.0"},
        },
    })


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "requested_version,header_version,expected_version",
    [
        ("2024-11-05", None, "2024-11-05"),
        ("2025-03-26", None, "2025-03-26"),
        ("2025-06-18", "2025-06-18", "2025-06-18"),
        ("2025-11-25", "  2025-11-25  ", "2025-11-25"),
        ("2099-01-01", None, "2025-11-25"),
        ("2025-06-18", "2099-01-01", "2025-06-18"),
        ("2025-06-18", "", "2025-06-18"),
    ],
)
def test_gateway_initialize_protocol_version_negotiation(
    monkeypatch, requested_version, header_version, expected_version
):
    with _gateway_with_real_upstream(monkeypatch) as client:
        extra = {} if header_version is None else {"MCP-Protocol-Version": header_version}
        reply = _post(client, body=_init_payload(requested_version), **extra)
    assert reply.status_code == 200
    data = reply.json()
    assert data["result"]["protocolVersion"] == expected_version
    assert data["result"]["serverInfo"]["name"] == "EDARSAHUB Universal Worker"


def test_gateway_handshake_initialized_and_tools_list_discovery(monkeypatch):

        notif_reply = _post(

        tools_reply = _post(

def test_gateway_validates_external_origin_and_strips_it_before_loopback(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "EDARSAHUB_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS",
        "https://chatgpt.com,http://localhost:*",
    )
    with _gateway_with_real_upstream(monkeypatch) as client:
        ok_chatgpt = _post(
            client,
            body=_init_payload("2025-06-18"),
            Origin="https://chatgpt.com",
        )
        assert ok_chatgpt.status_code == 200

        ok_localhost = _post(
            client,
            body=json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/list", "params": {}}),
            Origin="http://localhost:5173",
            **{"MCP-Protocol-Version": "2025-06-18"},
        )

        ok_same_origin = _post(

                "X-Forwarded-Proto": "https",
                "X-Forwarded-Host": "edarsahub.example.com",
            },
        )
        assert ok_same_origin.status_code == 200

        denied_origin = _post(
            client,
            body=_init_payload("2025-06-18"),

        )

        assert denied_origin.text == "Invalid Origin header"

        empty_origin = _post(

            body=_init_payload("2025-06-18"),
            Origin="   ",
        )

def test_gateway_preserves_oauth_bearer_authentication(monkeypatch):
    with _gateway_with_real_upstream(monkeypatch) as client:
        missing_auth = client.post(
            "/api/mcp",
            content=_init_payload("2025-06-18"),
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Accept": "application/json, text/event-stream",
                "X-Forwarded-Proto": "https",
                "X-Forwarded-Host": "edarsahub.example.com",
            },
        )
        assert missing_auth.status_code == 401
        challenge = missing_auth.headers.get("www-authenticate", "")
        assert "https://edarsahub.example.com/api/mcp/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" in challenge
        assert "127.0.0.1" not in challenge

        bad_token = _post(
            client,
            body=_init_payload("2025-06-18"),
            Authorization="Bearer invalid-token",
        )
        assert bad_token.status_code == 401
